questions.question: The savings of Radha are equal to 40% of her expenditure. If her income increases by 25% and the expenditure increases by 40%, then her savings increase/decrease by how much?
questions.solution:
Given:

The savings of Radha are equal to 40% of her expenditure.

Her income increases by 25% and her expenditure increases by 40%.

Concept used:

Income = Expenditure + Savings

Incremented/Reduced value = Initial value (1 ± change%)

Calculation:

Let the expenditure of Radha be 100p.

Her savings = 100p × 40% = 40p

Her income = 100p + 40p = 140p

Later,

Her income = 140p + 140p × 25% = 175p

Her expenditure = 100p + 100p × 40% = 140p

Her savings = 175p - 140p = 35p

Now, her savings decreased by = {{40p - 35p} over 40p} times 100\% = 12.5%

**∴ Her savings decreased by 12.5%.**

questions.question: If an integer 'k' is divisible by 3, 5 and 10 , then what will be the next larger integer divisible by all these numbers?
questions.solution:
Given:

An integer 'k' is divisible by 3, 5 and 10.

Concept used:

LCM is the smallest common multiple of two or more numbers.

Calculation:

LCM (3, 5, 10) = 30

Since 'k' is divisible by 3, 5, and 10, k must be a multiple of 30.

So, only 2k is a possible multiple of 30 here.

**∴ 2k will be the next larger integer divisible by all these numbers.**

questions.question: A and B can do a piece of work in 36 days and 48 days, respectively. They work together for 12 days. The remaining work is completed by C alone in 10 days. A and C together can complete 62.5% of the original work in:
questions.solution:
Given:

A and B can do a piece of work in 36 days and 48 days, respectively.

They work together for 12 days.

The remaining work is completed by C alone in 10 days.

Concept used:

Total work = Work done per day × Total time taken

Calculation:

LCM (36, 48) = 144

Let the total work be the LCM of the time taken by different workers.

So, total work = 144 units

A does each day = 144/36 = 4 units

B does each day = 144/48 = 3 units

Work done in 12 days by A and B together = 12(4 + 3) = 84 units

Remaining work = 144 - 84 = 60 units

So, C does each day = 60/10 = 6 units

Now, A and C together can complete 62.5% of the original work in

⇒ (144 × 62.5%)/(4 + 6)

⇒ 90/10 = 9 days

**∴ A and C together can complete 62.5% of the original work in 9 days.**

questions.question: A certain sum amounts to Rs. 13860 after 5 years and to Rs. 16776 after 8 years at the same rate per cent per annum at simple interest. What will be simple interest (in Rs.) on a sum of Rs. 20,000 for 3 (2)/(5) years at the same rate?
questions.solution:
Given:

A certain sum amounts to Rs. 13860 after 5 years and to Rs. 16776 after 8 years at the same rate per cent per annum at simple interest. 

Concept used:

Simple Interest, SI = (P × R × T)/100

Amount = P + SI

where, P = Principal amount, R = Rate of interest per year

T = Time in years

3 (2)/(5) years = 3.4 years

Calculation:

Let the rate of interest be R%.

Interest incurred in 3 years = 16776 - 13860 = Rs. 2916

Internet incurred per year = 2916/3 = Rs. 972

So, the principal amount = 13860 - 972 × 5 = Rs. 9000

According to the concept,

(9000 × R × 1)/100 = 972

⇒ R = 97200/9000

⇒ R = 10.8

Now, the simple interest incurred on Rs. 20,000 for 3 (2)/(5) years at the same rate

⇒ (20000 × 10.8 × 3.4)/100

⇒ Rs. 7344

**∴ The simple interest incurred on Rs. 20,000 for 3 (2)/(5) years at the same rate is Rs. 7344.**

questions.question: Three articles are bought at Rs. 500 each. One of them is sold at a profit of 12%. If the other two articles are also sold and a loss of 20% occurs on the whole transaction, then what is the gain or loss percentage on selling the remaining two articles?
questions.solution:
Given:

Three articles are bought at Rs. 500 each. One of them is sold at a profit of 12%.

The other two articles are also sold and a loss of 20% occurs on the whole transaction.

Concept used:

Loss% = {(Cost Price - Selling Price) over Cost Price} times 100\%

Selling Price = Cost Price + Cost Price × Gain%

Selling Price = Cost Price - Cost Price × Loss%

Calculation:

Total cost price of the articles = 500 × 3 = Rs. 1500

Selling price of the article that's sold at a profit of 12%

⇒ 500 + 500 × 12% = Rs. 560

Total selling price = 1500 - 1500 × 20% = Rs. 1200

Total selling price of the other two articles = 1200 - 560 = Rs. 640

Total cost price of the other two articles = 500 × 2 = RS. 1000

Now, loss% = {{1000 - 640} over 1000} times 100\% = 36%

**∴ The loss percentage on selling the remaining two articles is 36%.**

questions.question: A can do a piece of work in 15 days working 6 hours per day and B can do it in 10 days working 5 hours per day. How long (in days) will they take to do it, working together for 9 hours per day?
questions.solution:
Given:

A can do a piece of work in 15 days working 6 hours per day and B can do it in 10 days working 5 hours per day. 

Concept used:

Total work = Efficiency of worker × Number of Hours × Number of days to finish

Calculation:

Let the efficiencies of A and B be M and N respectively.

Total work = 15 × 6 × M = 90M (Considering A's perspective)

According to the concept,

15 × 6 × M = 10 × 5 × N

⇒ 9M = 5N

⇒ N = 1.8M

Now, the time taken to complete the work by A and B working together for 9 hours per day

⇒ 90M ÷ 9(M + N)

⇒ 10M ÷ (M + 1.8M)

⇒ 10M ÷ 2.8M

⇒ 3 (4)/(7) days

**∴ Working together for 9 hours per day A and B will take 3 (4)/(7) days to complete the work.**

questions.question: Sita scored 756 marks out of 900 and her brother Avi scored 350 marks out of 500. How many more marks should Avi get to make his score per cent equivalent to Sita?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sita's percentage = 756 ÷ 9 = 84%

Avi's target marks = 84% of 500 = 420 marks

Marks required to reach target = 420 − 350 = 70 marks

**∴ The correct answer is 70 marks.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sita's marks = 756 out of 900

Avi's marks = 350 out of 500

**Formula Used:**

Percentage = (Obtained Marks ÷ Total Marks) × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b5d8405721eec281f4fce710e1826140c984f261ffce0e9f52f3dc96ad70532d.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sita's score percentage = (756 ÷ 900) × 100 = 84%

⇒ To make his score percentage equivalent to Sita, Avi must also score 84%.

⇒ Avi's target marks = 84% of 500

⇒ Avi's target marks = (84 ÷ 100) × 500 = 420 marks

⇒ Current marks of Avi = 350 marks

⇒ Marks Avi needs to score more = 420 − 350 = 70 marks

**∴ The correct answer is 70 marks.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Formula

Percentage is calculated as the ratio of a specific value to the total value, multiplied by 100. Formula: (Value ÷ Total Value) × 100%.

Finding Value from Percentage

If a percentage is given, the specific value can be found by multiplying the percentage by the total base value. Formula: Value = (Percentage × Total Value) ÷ 100.

Base of Percentage

When comparing percentages of two different totals, the absolute values will differ even if the percentages are the same. The base refers to the denominator or total quantity.

questions.question: Seema and Geeta start at the same time to ride from place A to place B, which is 90 km away from A. Seema travels 3 km per hour slower than Geeta. Geeta reaches place B and at once turns back, meeting Seema 15 km from place B. Geeta's speed (in km/h) is:
questions.solution:
Given:

Seema and Geeta start at the same time to ride from place A to place B, which is 90 km away from A. 

Seema travels 3 km per hour slower than Geeta.

Geeta reaches place B and at once turns back, meeting Seema 15 km from place B.

Concept used:

Time × Speed = Distance

Calculation:

Let the speed of Seema be K km/h.

Speed of Geeta = (K + 3) km/h

Let AB be the distance between Place A and B and M be the meeting point of Seema and Geeta.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9cff3a5c1e03d55326df96531f6545bd193414a86ac28db46eb34c2f8f09b56b.png] 

According to the question,

BM = 15 km

AM = (90 - 15) = 75 km

Seema travelled total = 75 km

In the same time, Geeta travelled total = 90 + 15 = 105 km

According to the question,

105/(K + 3) = 75/K

⇒ 7/(K + 3) = 5/K

⇒ 7K = 5K + 15

⇒ 7K - 5K = 15

⇒ 2K = 15

⇒ K = 7.5

Now, Geeta's speed = 7.5 + 3 = 10.5 km/h

∴ Geeta's speed is 10.5 km/h.
